rationale: The workflow is a single macOS job that builds an iOS library with CMake. The only repeated network dependency fetch is `wget` of `ios.toolchain.cmake` from an unpinned `raw/master` URL. The dependency-cache pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is the closest candidate, and its measured examples (Go modules, Gradle) show benefit, but its preconditions require cache inputs to include a lockfile/environment and it contraindicates mutable or untrusted cached content. This workflow has no lockfile or dependency manifest to key cache invalidation, and the toolchain file is fetched from a mutable `raw/master` URL with no version pin, so a cache key cannot be safely invalidated without risking stale toolchain content. Other patterns do not apply: P-LIT-FAIL-FAST requires a matrix (single job, none), P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history (CI history records only conclusions, no durations), and schedule-based patterns require a schedule trigger (none). Preserving build coverage and avoiding new network access, no supported change is warranted.
